pkgmetadata.longdescription: Waydroid runs a full Android system (LineageOS based) inside an LXC container, using Linux namespaces and the kernel binder driver, and shows Android applications as windows of the host Wayland session. Graphics are accelerated through Mesa; other GPUs fall back to software rendering.

use.flag: Install the AppArmor profiles for the container and build app-containers/lxc with AppArmor support
Set up the container network with net-firewall/nftables instead of net-firewall/iptables
